arguments.question: What is the correct density series and lipid composition matrix for testing CBD partitioning, VDAC1 oligomerization, and native-condition CBD-VDAC1 Kd?
arguments.context: ChatGPT corrected the initial single-density 140:1 GUV design. The minimum discriminating design should include lipid-only, dilute VDAC, 140:1/native-proxy, and high-density patch conditions crossed with cholesterol/cardiolipin variation, plus nanodisc MST replication of the Rimmerman Kd under native lipid conditions.
